baseline_train_only.definition: Per-fold ExtraTrees refit on outer-train restricted to Train-split episodes only (mirrors the shipped 1,760-fitted head; fold-local size ~1,408).
baseline_train_only.name: fit-train-split-only

treatment_full_public.definition: Per-fold ExtraTrees refit on the full outer-train including Dev-split episodes (mirrors the full-public final fit; fold-local size ~2,112). Same recipe, same allocator, same uplift rank key.
treatment_full_public.name: fit-outer-full

context_frozen.note: Parent allocation, premium rows, families, digests and every brake constant come from the bundled artifact only. Both arms share the parent per fold.
context_frozen.rank_key: predicted delta-K descending (uplift), identical to the shipped runtime

decision_reasons.fail: Including Dev-split episodes in the brake-head training set does not clear the pre-registered diagnostic bar on fresh seeds. The full-public refit candidate stays recommended-off.
decision_reasons.pass: Training the same frozen recipe on more public episodes beats the Train-only fit on held-out folds on fresh seeds. This supports swapping the bundled brake forest to the full-public fit.

diagnostic_status.authority: Recommendation evidence for an operational final-fit swap only. It does not promote a model candidate and does not change any score gate of final-public-refit-v1.
diagnostic_status.seed_reuse_note: Seeds are freshly derived from the E5 decision core with a new prefix; E5 seeds themselves are not reused.

metric.delta_definition: paired Premium-tier official score difference (fit-outer-full minus fit-train-split-only) pooled per seed over held-out folds
metric.protocol: runtime-in-the-loop identical to e5-brake-conditioned-v1: shared parent from the shipped artifact, promotions through budget_brake_router.promote_premium_brake

seed_derivation.algorithm: digest_i = SHA256(UTF8(PREFIX) + NUL + bytes.fromhex(CORE) + i.to_bytes(4,'big')); seed_i = int.from_bytes(digest_i[:4],'big') & 0x7fffffff; collision fails closed.
